# dsh-bot-toggle

A floating **Bot / ADE** switch for the DSH web UI. It flips between the two interfaces that
ds-bot

brings — its **Bot** surface and the classic **ADE**
interface — with a single click, while **ds-bot

ot** surface and the classic **ADE**
interface — with a single click, while **ds-bot stays loaded**.
中文说明
## Why

ds-bot ships both interfaces but has no persistent switch: from the Bot surface you can only get
bac

k through its account menu, and from the classic interface you need its *DS Bot* return button.
This
plugin puts a small two-segment capsule on the right edge that is visible in both surfaces.
It is a UI layer on top of ds-bot, not a replacement for it: ds-bot keeps running the whole time.
## Features

- One-click switch between **Bot** and **ADE**; the active side is highlighted
- Available in both s

urfaces as a fixed overlay, kept clear of the content area
- Drag it anywhere, snap to an edge; righ

t-click resets to the default position (remembered)
- Keyboard shortcut `Alt+Shift+B`
- Fades after

4 s of no interaction, restores on hover; respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
- Bilingual UI (Chinese

/ English) following the page or browser language
- ds-bot compatibility probe: reports whether ds-b

ot is loaded and, when obtainable, its version;
if ds-bot's controls are missing, the capsule turns

amber with an explanation instead of
silently disappearing
## Screenshots
| Bot surface | Classic (ADE) surface |
## Requirements

- DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.3` (tested)
- ds-bot installed and enabled (tested with `0.2.

SH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.3` (tested)
- ds-bot installed and enabled (tested with `0.2.2`)
## Install
From DSH: **Settings → Plugins → add plugin**, then either

- the GitHub source `github:JackWoods-code/dsh-bot-toggle`, or
- the packaged `dsh-bot-toggle-<versi
on>.tgz` from Releases (or `npm pack` it yourself)
CLI equivalent: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:JackWoods-code/dsh-bot-toggle`.
If the plugin page says the change takes effect at the next start, restart DSH.
## Usage

- Click **Bot** to enter the ds-bot Bot surface, **ADE** to return to the classic DSH interface.
- D

rag the capsule to move it; right-click it to reset the position to the right edge, centered.
- Pres
s `Alt+Shift+B` to toggle from anywhere.
## Debugging
Open DevTools (Settings → Account → developer tools) and check the console:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The log prefix is `[bot-toggle]`.
## Compatibility probe

ds-bot exposes no public version API — `window.dshBot` is only its theme registry hub
(`registerShap
e` / `registerTheme` / `themes` / `shapes`). The probe therefore reads, in order:

1. `window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries` for an entry whose `id` / `name` / `package` is `ds-bot`
(and any `

version`, `pkg.version`, `manifest.version` it may carry),
2. `window.dshBot.version` (in case ds-bo

t adds one),
3. `document.body.dataset.dsBotVersion` (in case it adds one).

If ds-bot appears to be loaded but neither surface's controls exist, the capsule turns amber, the
to
oltip explains that the plugin may need an update, and `status().dsBot.compatible` is `false`.
## Known limitations

- **Surface switch only.** ds-bot stays loaded, so ordinary sessions still see ds-bot's tools
(`list

_bots`, `message_bot`, …). To unload ds-bot, disable it on the Plugins page instead.
- Switching rel

ies on ds-bot's own DOM: `.bt-return`, `.bt-account`, `.bt-account-menu` and the
localized *Switch t

o classic Agent mode* menu item. A ds-bot upgrade may move these; the
compatibility probe exists to

make that visible rather than silent.
- If neither interface can be detected, the capsule hides afte

ble rather than silent.
- If neither interface can be detected, the capsule hides after about 1.6 s.

op), `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `bot-toggle` plugin row.
